thread:
aisha: Heads-up — cloud partner notified us of a region-specific H100 price change for asia-southeast1, effective 2026-04-01. Finance did a high-level pass and this affects our Dedicated cost base for APAC customers. Need quick options and owners. 

lucas: How big is the delta? is this list-price only or affecting committed rates too?

aisha: Rough numbers from their notice: list H100 hourly +24% in asia-southeast1; committed discount tiers will see ~+18% on effective hourly after our current commit bands. Quick back-of-envelope: our APAC H100 spend ~ $1.2M/mo -> delta ~$216k/mo if we don’t change anything. 

mike_infra: Oof. Can we shift new provisioning to asia-east1/asia-northeast1? capacity wise we have spare pools in asia-east1 but need routing + region affinity changes. Latency tradeoffs for end-users?

jin_eng: For latency-sensitive customers (chat/real-time features) asia-southeast1 was preferred. Moving to east1 adds ~15-30ms p95 for some customers in SEA depending on egress path. Not ideal but maybe acceptable for non-critical workloads.

aisha: Scenario thinking: 1) absorb cost into margin for 90 days while we re-balance; 2) reprice Dedicated APAC SKUs (pass-through or partial); 3) remap lower-priority customers to other regions + add routing policy; 4) renegotiate with vendor for a regional commit addendum. Need modeled P&L for each.

lucas: Agreed. Can someone run three model scenarios (short-term absorb, partial pass-through, full pass-through + churn sensitivity) and include churn at 5/10/20%? I can take the partial pass-through model if someone gives me the input numbers.

aisha: Put a quick query in billing to grab actual APAC H100 hours and current effective rate by customer tier. Use this as start: 
```
SELECT region, sku, SUM(usage_hours) as hrs, AVG(effective_rate) as rate
FROM billing.h100_breakdown
WHERE month = '2026-02'
AND region LIKE 'asia_%'
GROUP BY region, sku;
```

ops-bot: Alert: asia-southeast1 average cluster utilization = 78% over last 7d; peak 95% (last 24h). Several scale-up events from Dedicated pools at 03:12 UTC yesterday.

sre-sarah: If we shift tens of thousands of hours out of sea1 we need to coordinate cluster autoscaler policies and node affinity. Also watch networking egress cost when crossing regions — that could erode savings.

mike_infra: Actionable short list: (A) run billing query (aisha), (B) infra to run simulated remap for 10%/30%/60% traffic (mike_infra + jin_eng), (C) finance churn scenarios (lucas), (D) vendor contact to ask about regional commit/top-up options (aisha). Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. Owners added above.

aisha: Ill post the billing result by EOD and a quick margin delta table. If anyone wants to add constraints (SLA, egress limits) drop them here. :eyes:
